question: Q4 Local-goods (domestic product) obligation
finding: PP 35/2024 requires franchisors and franchisees to "prioritise" (mengutamakan) domestic goods/services, for franchisees only as far as they meet the franchisor written quality standards; franchisors must cooperate with local MSMEs as suppliers and give local MSMEs the chance to become franchisees; franchise operators must also prioritise domestic raw-material processing. The text states no percentage quota and no ban on imports.

question: Q4 2025 amendment: Permendag 25/2025 on STPW issuance by regional governments
finding: Permendag 25/2025 (30 Jun 2025) sets the procedure for regional governments (incl. the DKI Governor) to issue STPW: verification and issuance within at most 5 working days, and if not issued in time the application receipt serves as provisional proof of franchise business until the STPW is issued. It applies to STPW of franchisees of domestic franchises and sub-franchisees; it takes effect 30 days after promulgation. It does not amend the criteria (3 years/2 years, F-04).
